Alfalfa Powder Exporter India: Dehydrated Alfalfa Leaf Powder

Tradenest Naturals is an alfalfa powder exporter in India supplying supplement brands, food manufacturers and feed producers. We supply fine, green alfalfa leaf powder made from carefully dried leaves. Every batch is produced to the same written specification for mesh, moisture and appearance. That is why brands in the USA, UK, Canada and Europe buy their wholesale alfalfa powder from us. Our alfalfa is carefully selected and sourced from trusted growers. The leaves are processed under hygienic conditions with no artificial colors added. The finished dehydrated alfalfa powder keeps its bright green color and fresh, grassy flavor. Full composition details are listed on the product specification sheet.

Processing Excellence and Technology

First, freshly harvested alfalfa leaves are inspected and cleaned. Next, they are dehydrated at controlled temperatures to remove moisture gently. The dried leaves are then milled and sieved into a fine, even powder. Finally, each batch is checked for moisture and mesh before packing. A product specification sheet is shared with every quotation, and third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost. We supply bulk alfalfa powder to buyers in many export markets. Whether you need our standard grade or a custom particle size, we aim for consistent quality. Our supply chain is built for regular shipments worldwide from India. Food safety and clear communication come first in every order.

Key Features and Specifications of Alfalfa Grass Powder

  • Processing: Dehydrated and finely milled.
  • Mesh Size: 80 to 100 mesh for a smooth texture.
  • Moisture Content: Below 7% to reduce caking and support a 24 month shelf life.
  • Appearance: Fine, free-flowing green powder.
  • Flavor Profile: Fresh, grassy and herbal taste.

Applications Across Diverse Industries

Alfalfa powder is used in several sectors. Supplement brands use it in green powder blends, capsules and tablets. Food and beverage makers add it to smoothies, green drinks and bakery premixes. It is also used in animal feed and pet food products. Alfalfa is traditionally used in herbal formulations.
  • Dietary supplement capsules and tablets.
  • Green drink mixes and smoothies.
  • Cosmetics and skincare formulations.
  • Animal feed and pet food products.

Buyer Value and Why Partner With Tradenest Naturals

When you buy wholesale alfalfa powder from us, you deal directly with the supplier. We offer OEM and private label alfalfa powder packing for your brand. Our alfalfa grass powder bulk price is set fairly for each volume tier. We also provide export documentation support and secure packing. Samples are available on request, and our sales team can send a quote quickly. Get in touch with Tradenest Naturals to discuss your requirement.

What is the minimum order quantity for alfalfa powder exporter india? The MOQ is 5 Kg. Contact our sales team for pricing based on your volume and packing.
